sources.notes: Claims below were captured in a claude.ai research session and have not been re-read by a person. The AV-SW build environment could not reach dmflighting.com.

families.name: DRD2 downlight system
families.description: Modular recessed downlight system. Input power varies by lumen package, so it belongs on each product record, taken from the DRD2 spec sheet.

conditions: Confirm the specific Lutron dimmer or module against DMF's current compatibility documentation.

review.notes: Research session summary: DMF says DRD modules perform well with dimming panels from Lutron, Crestron, Savant and Control4. Verify the wording on the page.

conditions: Confirm the specific Savant dimmer or module against DMF's current compatibility documentation.

review.notes: Same source claim as dmf-drd2-with-lutron-dimming. Verify the wording on the page.

rules.title: Hold dimmers without a published LED rating to 50%
rules.description: DMF guidance: a dimmer with no published LED rating should carry no more than half of its rated load when driving DRD modules.

review.notes: Captured in a claude.ai research session. Verify the 50% figure and its wording on the page before approving.
